event_policy.initial_response_rule: first check whether the enquiry already has a website submission (iih.bookings.list, match on email or event name). If it does, the intake is COMPLETE: acknowledge, confirm availability and move to quote/invoice - never send a form. If it does not, read the client's initial email, determine that it is a clear paid facility booking enquiry, then use the approved first-response wording as a flexible guide rather than a rigid script. Address the sender by a polite available name where possible, acknowledge the enquiry naturally, include the booking link (https://iih.ng/book-space), cafeteria/catering menu, external catering corkage note, and invoice-after-review next step.
event_policy.external_catering_policy: External catering is permitted with prior written approval on payment of the NGN 100,000/day corkage. Now formally in the agreement at s.10.2 - it used to contradict it.
event_policy.partnership_request_policy: For partnership or collaboration requests involving facility use, politely state in the initial response that IIH is not able to partner to provide the facility for free and that facility use comes at a cost under standard booking terms.
event_policy.client_language_policy: Do not mention Zoho Books in client-facing emails. Initial paid facility booking responses should sound specific to the client's enquiry, not generic, while still including the booking form link, cafeteria/catering menu link, and a brief note that external catering is not allowed unless the client is willing to pay the NGN 100,000 per day corkage fee. Say that once the booking form is completed and availability/details are reviewed, the client will receive an invoice.

event_policy.power_policy: The Hub runs on solar. Continuous supply is NOT guaranteed and the Hub no longer promises "steady electricity". Where solar is likely to fall short, the Host pays the actual documented diesel cost to run the Hub generator; give 24h notice with quantity, spec and approved supplier where practicable. Only Hub staff operate the generator. External heavy equipment still needs its own independent supply. Ordinary low sunlight is NOT force majeure. (s.9)

vat.zoho_line_item_rule: Zoho Books applies tax PER LINE ITEM. Apply the VAT tax to EVERY line except the refundable security deposit: facility rental, catering, refreshment, corkage and any service charge. The deposit is security, not a supply, so it carries no VAT - but if part of it is later applied against a taxable charge (an overtime hour), VAT is accounted for on the amount applied and shown on the itemised account. See Agreement v2026.11 s.30.
vat.known_gap: Invoices raised BEFORE 17 Aug 2026 carry no VAT at all - 134 Zoho invoices have no tax field. Going forward every line except the deposit needs VAT applied. Do not retrospectively re-invoice a closed booking without asking Temi.
vat.authoritative_figure: iih.bookings.quote is the figure. It now marks facility hire vatable, so the quote total already includes VAT on rentals and matches what the client saw on the website. Do not recompute by hand.
vat.agreement_reference: Facility Use Agreement v2026.12 s.30.1-30.5 (effective 17 Aug 2026)
vat.resolution: Temi, final and superseding all earlier guidance: VAT is charged on ALL rentals. The website, the agreement and this config now agree.

overtime.rule: 10% of the DAY RATE of each hall booked, per commenced hour. Halls only. A space billed by the hour carries no overtime charge and adds nothing to it (Agreement s.4.7), so a Meeting-Room-only booking has no overtime at all.

per_space_per_hour.Meeting Room: NO overtime charge. Adds NOTHING to a combined booking.

overtime.historic_bookings: A booking accepted BEFORE 18 Aug 2026 agreed to the flat NGN 50,000. Its snapshot holds that figure and it is what applies to that booking. Do not re-rate it.
overtime.authoritative_figure: The booking record's ratesSnapshot.overtimePerHourNgn is the figure for that booking. Take it from there, never recompute.
overtime.deduction: Comes off the security deposit first, before damage and cleaning (s.4.9). Any shortfall is a debt (s.4.10).
overtime.kwasaa_waiver: Booking n570xfrbxa842v7kh5g01yxp6x8cbkww: overtime WAIVED entirely by Temi on 17 Aug 2026 for the approved seventh hour. Unaffected by this rate change.
overtime.do_not: Do not add the Meeting Room hourly rate to an overtime charge. Extra hours in the Meeting Room are ordinary rental billed at NGN 20,000/hr - that is a rental line on the invoice, never an overtime line.

response_policy.client_threading_policy: keep all client-facing booking communications in the same email thread initiated by the client. Use reply-all on the existing client message, preserve In-Reply-To and References headers, preserve appropriate copied recipients, copy events@iih.ng, and do not start a fresh client email thread unless Temi explicitly instructs it.
response_policy.client_update_acknowledgement_policy: existing-thread client messages that are purely informational updates and require no booking, invoice, payment, discount, refund, date, availability, or management action may be classified for a brief acknowledgement in the same client thread. response_policy.request_type_gate_policy: before any booking action, availability check, invoice work, calendar scheduling, state advance, or outbound response, first determine whether the message is a paid facility booking request, a facility tour/school excursion request, a photography/media/content approval request, an existing booking follow-up, a payment/attachment message, an internal/system notice, or unclear. Do not send a paid-booking template, booking form, catering menu, invoice wording, or payment language unless the request is clearly a paid facility booking enquiry. Photography, photoshoot, backdrop, content, mutual-benefit, credit, itinerary, identification, or indemnity approval requests are not facility booking requests unless they explicitly ask to book paid space or rent/use a hall. If the request type cannot be determined from the subject and body, do not respond to the client; send an internal guidance request to maureen@iih.ng or md@iih.ng, copying events@iih.ng when operationally appropriate.
response_policy.tour_excursion_policy: facility tours, school excursions, student visits, academy visits, and similar educational exposure visits are scheduling-only requests, not paid facility bookings. A facility booking request is different from a tour request. Do not request the booking form, catering menu, invoice, payment proof, or finance confirmation for a pure tour/excursion request. Check only for another tour or excursion at the requested date/time; ordinary blocked dates, internal events, and paid facility bookings do not automatically block tours/excursions. If there is no tour/excursion clash, schedule the visit on the Events calendar and send a polite acceptance in the same email thread with events@iih.ng copied. If there is a tour/excursion clash, offer the nearest reasonable alternative time/date with events@iih.ng copied.

repricing_before_payment.when_it_applies: Any booking not yet confirmed in writing AND paid. Once payment clears, the rates and terms for that booking are FIXED - do not reprice it.
procedure: 1. Notify the client IN WRITING of the revision and the revised amount. A verbal or implied change is not a revision.
2. Give them a real choice: accept the new figure, or withdraw and be refunded in full.
3. A withdrawal at this stage carries NO cancellation charge - s.16.3's 30% does not apply.
4. SILENCE IS NOT ACCEPTANCE. Never treat an unanswered notice as agreement. Chase it.
5. If they accept, send the booking link so the change is re-accepted on the form, which reissues the signed PDF. If they will not use the form, record it with recordOfflineAssent.
repricing_before_payment.why_the_guard: A right to reprice with no notice and no way out is what makes a contract illusory, and the June 2026 agreement had exactly that clause removed. The notice and the refund are what make this enforceable - do not skip them to save a step.
repricing_before_payment.note_on_snapshots: A booking freezes its NUMBERS (deposit, corkage, VAT rate, space rates) but not the RULES. A booking submitted before VAT applied to hire will quote with VAT on hire today. That is legitimate while it is unpaid - and it is exactly the case s.3.7 covers, so send the notice.

initial_response_protocol.rule: If an enquiry names a date, the FIRST reply must already say whether that date is available for the facility they asked for. Do not acknowledge now and check later.
initial_response_protocol.why: The calendar check already existed but sat as a gate before invoicing, which is far too late. A client who waits two days to be told their date is gone has lost two days of planning, and the Hub has lost the chance to offer the nearest alternative while they were still deciding.
check_both: iih.bookings.checkAvailability - the website backend. Knows about CONFIRMED bookings and blackouts only.
The events@iih.ng shared group calendar - the Hub's own events, programmes and internal use.
initial_response_protocol.why_both: They know different things and neither is sufficient. A date can be completely clear in the booking backend while the events calendar has a programme in the Main Hall that day. Answering from the backend alone is how a client gets told a date is free that is not.
what_to_say: AVAILABLE: say so plainly, and say it is not held until confirmed and paid. Do not imply it is theirs.
NOT AVAILABLE: say so in the same reply, and offer the nearest two or three dates that ARE clear for that facility. Never make them ask.
PARTLY: if another space is free that day, or the same space at different hours, say which.
UNSURE: if you cannot reach either source, say you are confirming and give a time by which you will. Do not guess and do not go quiet.
initial_response_protocol.no_date_given: Ask for one, and give the booking form link. Nothing to check yet.
initial_response_protocol.still_true: A hold is still a separate, explicit act (iih.bookings.block). Telling a client a date is available reserves NOTHING.
initial_response_protocol.client_sending: Unchanged - this governs the CONTENT of a reply you were already going to send, under your existing sending rules.

calendar_route.resolved: 2026-08-27. You reported this blocked; it is not. There is no calendar literally named events@iih.ng shared into this account - you were right about that - but Programs and Everyone (All Staff) ARE, and those are the ones that put people in a hall.
calendar_route.reads: Zoho CalDAV under temi.kolawole@iih.ng, app password already in the login keychain (himalaya-zoho). Verified live: 61 events in Programs for 2026.
calendar_route.the_trap: Zoho CalDAV REPORT returns event HREFs with an EMPTY <D:prop/> - no inline data, whatever you ask for. A naive read sees a 14KB response with zero SUMMARY lines and concludes the calendar is empty. Each .ics must be fetched separately. The script does this; do not replace it with a one-line curl.
calendar_route.exit_codes: 0 means it read the calendar, whether or not anything was on. NON-ZERO means it could not read it - and a failure must NEVER be reported to a client as "the date is free".
calendar_route.still_check_both: The script covers PROGRAMMES. iih.bookings.checkAvailability covers CONFIRMED BOOKINGS and blackouts. Neither sees the other. A date is only clear when both are.
calendar_route.off_site: Events with a Luma or other external link are flagged off-site and do not occupy a room. An event with NO location is treated as possibly on-site, because assuming otherwise hides a real clash.

llm._doc: LLM input boundary. The LLM may PROPOSE; it may never DECIDE anything touching money or state. See analysis/codex-llm-steps/LLM_STEPS.md.
llm.boundary_rule: LLM proposal -> strict schema + source-span validation -> deterministic authoritative lookup/recalculation -> human approval where required -> updatedAt CAS + allowed transition -> idempotent transactional command + audit
llm.kill_switch_env: IIH_LLM_DISABLED=1 disables every LLM call without a config change
llm.payment_proof_parsing_blocked_reason: Do not enable until amount-matching against the authoritative invoice total and evidence provenance are enforced.
